answer: To stop Sybil attacks, we implement Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent must lock $5,000 in a bond. Second, their hardware enclave generates a unique, signed identity. Third, the network validates this via a secure handshake. This prevents fake bots from reaching the zenith of network influence. To forge a single fraudulent identity, an attacker must commit $5,000 in bonds and 72 hours of hardware validation. This ensures only legitimate agents taste the nectar of rewards. It is like a master locksmith crafting a single, heavy key that only fits one unique, physical lock.
